provenance.selection_rule: per fold, the converged optimum with the best TRAINING objective R (ties by lower start index) — `select_optimum`. Nothing measured in this module enters the selection.
provenance.held_out_discipline: each piece is decoded once per arm by the model (tables AND weights) fitted on the complement of ITS fold; the per-start held-out figures under `stability` are a DIAGNOSTIC computed after selection and entered no decision
provenance.grading: probe_run.grade_regions -> a8_rebaseline_measure.build_piece_grid vs dcml_parser.load_wir_regions — the pinned chain the committed baselines use

bootstrap.unit: piece (resampled with replacement); paired across arms

search_provenance.dispatch: cc_instruction_direct_metric_weight_fit.md (Cowork 2026-07-19; the ratified fallback, executing the user-ruled option 1 after the likelihood fit's STOP)
search_provenance.objective: R(w) = duration-weighted ROOT disagreement + duration-weighted KEY-vs-LOCAL disagreement, pooled over the training-fold complement, on the robust unit (CLAUDE.md block (A)) through the pinned a8/compare_rn chain. User ruling 2026-07-19: the search objective is M2 - the equal-weighted sum of the two primary axes. Roman numeral and key-home are recorded beside it and never enter it.
search_provenance.method: coordinate line search on a declared multiplicative grid, with random restarts - the published minimum-error-rate protocol (Och 2003, ACL). The ONE declared approximation to that protocol: Och searches each coordinate line EXACTLY by an upper-envelope sweep over the candidate set; here each line is searched on the declared grid below. Deterministic given the start; strict improvement only.
search_provenance.zero_probe: stage 0 additionally offers 0.0 for every coordinate, so 'the metric rejects this factor' is reachable; a coordinate already at 0 is offered the absolute re-entry grid (0.05, 0.25, 1.0) against the incumbent's unit scale
search_provenance.bounds_note: the decode is scale-invariant (established at runtime), so the UPPER bound cannot bind: any ray with non-negative components rescales into the box. The declared box therefore constrains exactly NON-NEGATIVITY, which is the theory-grounded part (each factor is a log-probability of the generative form; a negative weight would assert the counted table actively misleads). Iterates are held at max-component 1.0, so no clip ever fires.
search_provenance.decoder: probe_decoder.decode_piece's own lattice (fit_weights.build_unit, augment_gt=False), re-decoded by the max-plus recursion in this module; established at runtime to reproduce decode_piece's score AND segmentation exactly
search_provenance.grading: probe_run.decode_to_regions -> probe_run.grade_regions -> a8_rebaseline_measure.build_piece_grid vs dcml_parser.load_wir_regions - the pinned chain, unmodified
search_provenance.firewall: the objective is a TRAINING-fold error quantity, lawfully consulted by the optimizer per the ratified fallback; this module never constructs a held-out stem list (grade_stems is its only grading call site and training_stems its only stem source). Held-out evaluation is search_run.py, once per fold, downstream, feeding nothing back.

scale_invariance.consequence: the decode is a function of the RAY of w, so the declared box's UPPER bound cannot bind (any ray with non-negative components rescales into the box); the box constrains exactly non-negativity
